description:
A self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality.

Creality Print is a self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality. It’s a practical and easy-to-use tool that can help you remote control and monitor your 3D printer and help print directly from your computer.
1. Improved how the SPARK i8 calculates the combined purge volume for scheduled pre-purging and color changes. Purge volume now adjusts based on how long the filament has been idle, reducing unnecessary purging and filament waste from the wipe tower.

2. Rounded the outer corners of the wipe tower to reduce frequent acceleration and deceleration, keeping extrusion pressure more stable during printing.

3. Updated the Online Parameters page to show only parameter packages for printers you’ve added.

4. Fixed an issue where travel moves after a filament change skipped Z-hop, allowing residual filament to leave color streaks on the model surface.

5. Improved object splitting so that suspended parts can retain their original Z positions.

6. Fixed an issue where the time-lapse toggle on the Send page could get out of sync with the printer’s settings.

7. Fixed an issue where the action buttons next to a custom process preset disappeared after loading a model.
